title: DNS Gateway fields in the DNS log: slot, server protocol and flags

prose.text: Three fields carry the DNS Gateway outcome. {{dnsgw-slot-proto}}

prose.label: Flags.
prose.text: {{dnsgw-flag-glosses}} {{failure-behavior-options}} Whether the flags are exclusive, their order and how they map to the failure behavior are open {{gap:dnsgw-flags-semantics-open}}.
The general outcome fields are in [[zia.logs.dns-outcome]] and naming in [[zia.logs.dns-record-fields]].

checks.do: Which glossed meaning the dnsgw_flags value carries, and whether failover behavior is configured on the gateway.
Whether one record can show several flags, before filtering on equality.

dnsgw-slot-proto.statement: The dnsgw_slot field is the name of the DNS Gateway rule, shown in Insights as Resolver Gateway, and dnsgw_srv_proto is the DNS Gateway server protocol, with TCP, UDP and HTTP as examples.

quotes: | %s{dnsgw_slot} | The name of the DNS Gateway rule | DNS GATEWAY Rule 1 | Resolver Gateway
| %s{dnsgw_srv_proto} | The DNS Gateway server protocol | TCP, UDP, HTTP | Server Protocol

dnsgw-flag-glosses.statement: The CSV glosses the dnsgw_flags values as PRIMARY_SERVER_RESPONSE_PASS for Primary Server Attempted, SECONDARY_SERVER_RESPONSE_PASS for Secondary Server Attempted, FO_DEST_PASS for Query Forwarded to Destination, FO_DEST_ERR for Error Response Returned to Client and FO_DEST_DROP for Query Dropped, with None also listed.

quotes: | %s{dnsgw_flags} | Flags indicating the DNS Gateway status for the transaction | PRIMARY_SERVER_RESPONSE_PASS (i.e., Primary Server Attempted)SECONDARY_SERVER_RESPONSE_PASS (i.e., Secondary Server Attempted)
FO_DEST_PASS (i.e., Query Forwarded to Destination)FO_DEST_ERR (i.e., Error Response Returned to Client)FO_DEST_DROP (i.e., Query Dropped)None | DNS Gateway Flags |

failure-behavior-options.statement: A DNS gateway is configured with a failure behavior of either Return error response or Forward to Original DNS Server.

quotes: The failure behavior for the gateway (i.e., **Return error response** or **Forward to Original DNS Server**).

dnsgw-flags-semantics-open.title: Whether dnsgw_flags values are exclusive and how they map to gateway failure behavior
dnsgw-flags-semantics-open.blocks: diagnosing why a gateway DNS query failed
dnsgw-flags-semantics-open.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the CSV does not expand "FO", does not say whether values are one per record or cumulative, does not give the transition order between primary, secondary and FO_* states, does not distinguish when FO_DEST_ERR fires versus FO_DEST_DROP, and does not say when None appears. Whether FO_DEST_ERR and FO_DEST_DROP correspond to the gateway failure behaviors is not stated (legacy clarification log-16).
